machine: UNAM hpclab-RTXA6000, RTX 6000 Ada, CC (8,9) = the L40S generation

size.verdict: PASS — and BETTER than the extrapolation. The 0.756 came from a 4.25 GiB smoke model; at 27B scale the Linear layers dominate and the ratio improves. The prediction that the bf16 vision tower would make it WORSE was wrong.
size.scheme: FP8_DYNAMIC, targets=Linear, no calibration data required

serving_one_card.root_cause: HF transformers + compressed_tensors DEQUANTIZES the FP8 weights back to bf16 rather than executing native FP8 kernels. Reproduced with dtype=torch.bfloat16 AND dtype='auto', so it is not a load-time flag we set wrong.
serving_one_card.implication: The 33.46 GiB file does not mean 33.46 GiB resident. Under this runtime it expands toward the 51.75 GiB bf16 footprint and will not fit a 48 GB card.

packaging_defect.finding: llmcompressor's output_dir contains only weights + config + recipe. It has NO preprocessor_config.json, tokenizer, vocab, merges or chat template.
packaging_defect.consequence: The quantized checkpoint is NOT servable as produced — AutoProcessor raises. Those files must be copied from the source snapshot.
packaging_defect.relevance: This is a submission-container step that would have failed offline, where nothing can be fetched.

env_defect.finding: orena-quant lacked torchvision, which Qwen3VLVideoProcessor requires.
env_defect.fix_applied: installed torchvision==0.26.0+cu128 into ~/storage/envs/orena-quant, matching its torch 2.11.0+cu128

still_open.vllm: NOT installed in any UNAM env. CLAUDE.md prescribes serving via `vllm serve --quantization fp8`, which is the path that executes native FP8 w8a8 on Ada. It is now the ONLY untested link in the deployability claim.
still_open.latency: not measured — the model never loaded on one card, so no p50/p99 exists yet
still_open.variant_B: quantizing the vision tower too (to isolate what leaving it bf16 costs) not run
